title: understudy.app_harness.v1
description: app-harness.json sidecar in a benchmark directory: how the run executor launches the user's OWN application per frozen task for the app_replay arm. The executor injects the gateway redirect env vars (OPENAI_BASE_URL/ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL -> the Understudy gateway, UNDERSTUDY_API_KEY) plus UNDERSTUDY_TASK_ID / UNDERSTUDY_TASK_PROMPT / UNDERSTUDY_LIVE_JOURNAL, waits per_task_timeout_seconds, and scores observed tool events through the shared contract scorer. Tier-1 observation boundary: only tool calls surfaced in the live journal are scorable; an unobserved rollout is recorded with the app_replay_unobserved anomaly, never fabricated. Producers may add extra fields; consumers must ignore fields they do not understand.

schema_version.description: Version stamp for this harness shape.

command.description: Argv vector: command[0] is the executable, the rest its fixed arguments. In input_mode argv, the task prompt is appended as the final argument.

cwd.description: Working directory for the app; absolute, or relative to the benchmark directory (default: the benchmark directory).

env.description: Extra env vars merged over the parent env. The executor's gateway redirect + task-input vars always win last (a harness cannot re-route the LLM traffic away from the gateway).

input_mode.description: How the task input reaches the app: argv (prompt appended as the last argument), stdin (one JSON line {task_id, prompt}), or http (endpoint template; schema-valid in v1 but not executable by the tier-1 runner). UNDERSTUDY_TASK_ID / UNDERSTUDY_TASK_PROMPT env vars are set in every mode.

url_template.description: Endpoint template; {task_id} and {prompt} placeholders are substituted per task.

body_template.description: Request body template with the same placeholders.

http.description: Only allowed when input_mode is http.

per_task_timeout_seconds.description: Wall-clock budget per task rollout; the app subprocess is SIGKILLed on expiry and the row records the rollout_timeout anomaly (default 300).

llm_route.description: v1 fixes the LLM route to the Understudy gateway via the injected base-URL redirect vars.

tool_route.description: Where tool effects are observable from: gateway_tools (tool calls surfaced in the live journal via the gateway / a journal-honoring shim) or none (side effects are not observable; rollouts will honestly record app_replay_unobserved).

notes.description: Free-text authoring notes (how the harness was derived from the user's repo, known caveats).
